verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's Simulations product lets teams author adversarial scenarios (false authority claims, prompt injection) and run them as 'guardrail test scenarios,' and knowledge-base auditing flags gaps that could cause invented answers — implying some guardrail infrastructure exists. However, there is no explicit documentation describing the agent's actual decline/refusal behavior when a question falls outside its knowledge base, nor any first-party or independent evidence confirming it reliably declines rather than fabricates. Missing for 10: explicit description of the safe-decline mechanism itself, examples of it refusing off-knowledge questions, and independent verification that guardrails prevent hallucinated policies/prices.
